answers.question: How many days ago did I participate in the 5K charity run?
answers.gold: 7 days ago. 8 days (including the last day) is also acceptable.
lines: [2023-03-19] User: I'm looking for some new running routes in my area. I just got back into running and did a 5K charity run today, finishing in 27 minutes and 12 seconds, which was a great motivator. Do you have any recommendations for routes that are around 3-5 miles long?

[2023-03-14] User: I was also involved in a charity 5K run/walk recently, where I helped with registration and handed out water to the participants. Do you have any tips on how to pace myself during the bike ride, as I'm not sure if my running experience will translate to cycling?

[2023-03-10] User: I'm planning to run a charity event soon and I want to invite my friends and family to join me. Do you have any advice on how to prepare for it? By the way, I've been into running lately - I had been training for six months before my first marathon, and it was an incredible experience.
